details.description: Ministral 3 8B is a balanced, mid-sized model in Mistral AI's Ministral 3 family, an edge-optimized model line released December 2, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license. It pairs an 8.4B-parameter language model with a 0.4B-parameter vision encoder for combined text and image input. The instruction-tuned FP8 build (Mistral's API id 'ministral-8b-2512') supports native function calling, JSON-constrained output, and a 256K-token context window, and Mistral says it can be deployed locally in as little as 12GB of VRAM in FP8, or less when further quantized, on a single H200 GPU.
advantages: Scores 87.6% on MATH Maj@1 and an Arena Hard score of 50.9, per Mistral's instruct-model benchmark table on its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 66.8 on WildBench and 8.08 on MM MTBench (multimodal chat), per the same benchmark table.
Mistral says it can be deployed locally in as little as 12GB of VRAM in FP8, and less when further quantized.
Supports native function calling and JSON-constrained output, per its Hugging Face model card.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, allowing commercial and derivative use.
disadvantages: Text and image input only; Mistral's model card does not describe audio or video input support.
use_cases: General-purpose chat and instruction-following on a single mid-range GPU
Combined vision-and-text tasks such as image analysis and document understanding
Agentic applications using native function calling and JSON-constrained output

notes: This target's catalog id ('ministral-8b-2512') exactly matches Mistral's own La Plateforme API id and 'ministral-8b-latest' alias for Ministral 3 8B, confirmed on Mistral's docs page. Catalog's 262,144-token input/output limits match the 256K context window stated on Mistral's docs page and Hugging Face model card exactly, so no conflict there.
